{{Item infobox | name = The Frog | rarity = 4 | image = [[Image:The Frog (miniature).png]] | type = [[Miniature]] | campaign= [[Core]] | render = [[Image:The Frog (miniature).jpg|150px]] }} [[The Frog (miniature)]] is a [[miniature]] version of [[The Frog]]. It is completely unique and [[Gaile Gray]] is the only person to own one. It was a gift to her from the developers upon her leaving her role as [[ArenaNet]] Community Relations Manager, a position she held for more than five years. == Notes == * There are two alternate versions of the frog: A [[The Frog (Halloween)|Halloween version]] and a [[The Frog (Wintersday)|Wintersday version]]. == Trivia ==
